<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="4" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#000000" flood-opacity=".32"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#121826"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="22" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Roboto Mono" font-size="12px" font-weight="700">9:41</text>
    <line x1="299" y1="17" x2="299" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="304" y1="14" x2="304" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="309" y1="11" x2="309" y2="21" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="324" cy="17" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="322" y1="20" x2="326" y2="20" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="344" y="11" width="24" height="12" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="347" y="14" width="15" height="6" rx="1.5" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="369" y="15" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <polyline points="29,52 21,60 29,68" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="60" x2="38" y2="60" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="66" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="20px" font-weight="700">Payment methods</text>

    <!-- notification bell -->
    <circle cx="323" cy="48" r="3" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <rect x="316" y="51" width="14" height="13" rx="6" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="314" y1="65" x2="332" y2="65" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="323" cy="68" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <!-- settings -->
    <circle cx="361" cy="59" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="59" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="361" y1="47" x2="361" y2="51" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="361" y1="67" x2="361" y2="71" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="349" y1="59" x2="353" y2="59" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="369" y1="59" x2="373" y2="59" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  </g>

  <line x1="20" y1="88" x2="370" y2="88" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Warning banner -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="108" width="350" height="73" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity=".25"/>
    <rect x="20" y="105" width="350" height="73" rx="20" fill="#35383F"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="141" r="16" fill="#6C6C6C"/>
    <line x1="50" y1="132" x2="50" y2="143" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="50" cy="149" r="1.7" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="77" y="136" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="16px" font-weight="700">No payment method listed</text>
    <text x="77" y="158" fill="#DADADA" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400">Add one to keep your rides moving.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Empty state illustration -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="195" cy="285" r="87" fill="#8B232359"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="285" r="66" fill="#990000"/>
    <circle cx="195" cy="285" r="48" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <!-- card -->
    <rect x="156" y="263" width="78" height="52" rx="9" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <rect x="156" y="263" width="78" height="14" rx="9" fill="#F8A0A0"/>
    <line x1="164" y1="288" x2="199" y2="288" stroke="#6C6C6C" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="164" y1="298" x2="184" y2="298" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="207" y1="298" x2="226" y2="298" stroke="#C4C4C4" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="271" r="4" fill="#990000"/>
    <circle cx="226" cy="271" r="4" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <!-- plus -->
    <line x1="251" y1="245" x2="251" y2="267" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="240" y1="256" x2="262" y2="256" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <circle cx="126" cy="325" r="5" fill="#FEC949"/>
    <circle cx="273" cy="316" r="4" fill="#F8A0A0"/>
  </g>

  <text x="195" y="405" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="24px" font-weight="700">Add a payment method</text>
  <text x="195" y="433" text-anchor="middle" fill="#DADADA" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400">Save a card for faster, easier ticket purchases.</text>
  <text x="195" y="455" text-anchor="middle" fill="#DADADA" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="15px" font-weight="400">Your payment information stays secure.</text>

  <!-- Primary action -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="54" y="491" width="282" height="54" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity=".28"/>
    <rect x="54" y="488" width="282" height="54" rx="20" fill="#FF4D4D"/>
    <line x1="154" y1="515" x2="168" y2="515" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <line x1="161" y1="508" x2="161" y2="522" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="195" y="522" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="18px" font-weight="700">Set up</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Security information card -->
  <g>
    <rect x="20" y="582" width="350" height="91" rx="20" fill="#000000" opacity=".24"/>
    <rect x="20" y="579" width="350" height="91" rx="20" fill="#181A20" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
    <circle cx="51" cy="615" r="17" fill="#990000"/>
    <rect x="45" y="613" width="12" height="11" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <polyline points="47,613 47,608 49,605 53,605 56,608 56,613" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="79" y="609" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Urbanist" font-size="16px" font-weight="700">Secure and private</text>
    <text x="79" y="632" fill="#DADADA" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400">Only the last four digits will be visible</text>
    <text x="79" y="651" fill="#DADADA" font-family="PT Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400">after your card has been added.</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="742" width="390" height="102" fill="#181A20"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="742" x2="390" y2="742" stroke="#35383F" stroke-width="1"/>
  <g>
    <!-- Home -->
    <polygon points="39,773 50,764 61,773" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="43" y="772" width="14" height="12" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="50" y="810" text-anchor="middle" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Inter" font-size="11px" font-weight="400">Home</text>

    <!-- Tickets -->
    <rect x="112" y="765" width="25" height="18" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="770" x2="130" y2="770" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="120" y1="776" x2="130" y2="776" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="124" y="810" text-anchor="middle" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Inter" font-size="11px" font-weight="400">Tickets</text>

    <!-- Payment active -->
    <circle cx="195" cy="775" r="25" fill="#990000"/>
    <rect x="182" y="768" width="26" height="16" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="183" y1="773" x2="207" y2="773" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="188" y1="779" x2="196" y2="779" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.6"/>
    <text x="195" y="810" text-anchor="middle" fill="#FFFFFF" font-family="Inter" font-size="11px" font-weight="700">Payments</text>

    <!-- Routes -->
    <circle cx="273" cy="768" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <circle cx="287" cy="782" r="4" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="276" y1="771" x2="284" y2="779" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="280" y="810" text-anchor="middle" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Inter" font-size="11px" font-weight="400">Routes</text>

    <!-- Profile -->
    <circle cx="344" cy="769" r="6" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <ellipse cx="344" cy="784" rx="11" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#DADADA" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="344" y="810" text-anchor="middle" fill="#DADADA" font-family="Inter" font-size="11px" font-weight="400">Profile</text>
  </g>
</svg>
